projects.title: NASA Beyond the Algorithm Challenge, Winner ($100k)
projects.description: Won $100,000 first-place cash prize in a NASA competition against hundreds of students, professors, and companies.Developed Spike2Former-Flood, a spiking neural network fusing optical + SAR imagery for under 15 min flood mapping.Optimized on neuromorphic processors (Loihi 2, Akida) using <5W to enable autonomous in-orbit disaster intelligence.

projects.title: Recoverly
projects.description: Won the Best Use of Generative AI prize at Columbia DevFest 2025 amongst 66 competing teams.Built React/TypeScript frontend with Firebase (Auth, Firestore, Storage) & Flask backend for claims and PDF reporting.Engineered automated loss documentation by integrating Eden AI (object/text detection) and OpenAI (value estimation).

projects.title: NYC HAQ Hackathon
projects.description: Placed 2nd in Quantum Chemistry for effective simulation performance on noisy and noiseless backends.Simulated ground and excited states of Lithium Hydride (LiH) using VQE and compared with classical solvers (FCI, CCSD).Applied Density Matrix Embedding Theory to simulate metal hydrides for disease treatment, scaling to ~10 qubits.
